open_questions: The business checking procedure does not give the account_type value or the exact account_class format for open_bank_account_4821; 'checking' and 'Cobalt Blue' (the form in the doc's option list) are assumed.
Gold Saver Account has no documented withdrawal limit, minimum balance or relationship bonus, so it cannot be confirmed to meet those needs.
Emerald Saver's same-day ACH is 'No' (doc_business_savings_accounts_emerald_saver_007), so it fails a same-day need.

The savings procedure says to transfer the 'required opening deposit amount confirmed with the customer'. Silver Plus Saver documents a $5,000 minimum balance but no opening deposit, so the agent transfers the amount the customer confirms, up to the source balance.
